outputClaimId.title: outputClaimId
outputClaimId.description:
Internal Salesforce record ID of the warranty claim that was approved
or rejected.

outputClaimName.title: outputClaimName
outputClaimName.description:
Human-readable warranty claim reference that was processed,
used in confirmation responses.

outputDealerPhone.title: outputDealerPhone
outputDealerPhone.description:
Dealer contact phone number used for sending WhatsApp
or notification messages.

outputErrorMessage.title: outputErrorMessage
outputErrorMessage.description:
Error message returned if the approval or rejection action
could not be completed successfully.

outputSuccess.title: outputSuccess
outputSuccess.description:
Indicates whether the approve or reject action completed
successfully.

outputWhatsAppSent.title: outputWhatsAppSent
outputWhatsAppSent.description:
Indicates whether a WhatsApp notification was successfully
sent to the dealer as part of the decision process.
